svg.title: Editable Cousins Circle Chart
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the supplied PNG. All names are editable SVG text elements.

g.text: Legend: Each Band Represents One Generation
Blue Band: My parents, aunts and uncles
Yellow Band: My siblings and first cousins

text.tspan: Green Band: My children, nieces, nephews and
Pink Band: My grandchildren, great nieces and
great nephews, and my first cousins twice removed.
